properties.description: Review phase 1 with the user in the Changes UI editor. Select existing and newly authored web components without adding editor support to them; inspect available properties and preview changes; verify Code, Visual and Preview, error recovery and sizing. Check contributor ownership and absence of component-specific dependencies. Record feedback and iterate before proceeding to phase 2. Author must submit this review; approval remains the user's action.
properties.title: Review generic web component previews — phase 1

properties.description: Implement generic discovery and rendering of existing web components selected from TypeScript source. Language and web-component contributors own identity, public property schemas, source relationships and operations; the UI editor consumes them without component-specific dependencies, adapters, registration lists or uiDefinition requirements. Reuse the regular node editor, existing tabs, zoom and panel controls. Show the component with its own defaults; update exposed scalar properties live where possible. Keep Code editing and stale-write protection. Errors replace Visual/Preview content while tabs remain usable. Start at minimum size and zoom out to fit. Sample-data setup, injected services and live buildspace data are outside this phase. Verify arbitrary components through the same path and inspect the running review surface.
properties.title: Implement generic web component previews — phase 1
